Hi team,

As we close Q2, I want to consolidate manager handbacks for my org. Two asks:

1) Please fill the attached handback_template.docx with the one-paragraph summary for each direct report (performance, growth signal, open actions) and drop the file back here by EOD Thursday (6/17). I attached my partial manager_notes_draft.md so you can reuse phrasing.

2) There's a sensitive potential org change on one IC on my team (not public) that will likely need HR involvement before we finalize recommendations. Please do NOT copy the employee into this thread. I've looped in People Ops below as an external contact to start a discreet intake if needed.

Also attaching OKR_snapshot_Q2.xlsx — please highlight any goal redlines and note whether the priority for H2 should shift.

If we can get the consolidated doc by Thu, I will circulate a short summary to Execs and HR for any formal approvals.

Thanks — Rishi

--

Director, Platform
Redwood Inference
